verdict.rationale: Docs confirm the Supabase CLI can run the full stack locally and in CI environments (supabase-docs-21) and branching lets you test schema changes outside production (supabase-docs-10/17), implying a migrations-in-CI workflow, but the evidence pack never shows an actual migration/diff/push command being used. A hands-on community report explicitly states 'The local development & database migration story is Supabase's biggest weakness... I hate having to do migrations live in prod' (supabase-comm-7), directly contradicting the implied smooth CLI/CI migration workflow. missing for 10: explicit evidence of `supabase migration new`/`db push`/`db diff` commands, a documented CI pipeline example, and independent corroboration that migrations work reliably in production.
